scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute class-weighted mean negative log-likelihood and total contributing weight.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: -sum_i weight[target_i]*input[i,target_i]/sum_i weight[target_i], ignoring target32; also return totalweight.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 4096 samples x64 classes, labels and class weights.
invariants: Ignored labels contribute neither loss nor weight.
Positive totalweight required for the selected mean reduction.
accuracy_requirements: Both finite Float32 outputs checked at absolute1e-5; selected dyadic fixture, full dual-reference evidence.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 weighted sums and final division; Float16/native other thread-count cases unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Weighted classification-loss primitive; no specific dataset or learning task beyond the operator is identified.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Fixture inputs are synthetic negative values, not independently validated normalized log-probabilities.

scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
